I need to look at your training and nutrition to give you a straight answer. Nothing is logged in your nutrition or training yet, so I can't see what you're actually taking in. But I can tell you straight: one meal every two days is not enough fuel for building muscle, full stop. Muscle growth needs consistent protein and calories — you can't build tissue on half rations.

That said, this is a conversation for a doctor or dietitian, not me. If there's a reason you're eating that way — medical, financial, access — they can help you figure out what's realistic and safe. Once you've got that sorted, we build a training plan that fits what you can actually do.

What's the situation?
